index.shutdown_desc_2: (e.g. from Home Assistant before switching off a smart plug).
sources.heading: Image sources
sources.nc_verify_ssl_label: Verify SSL certificate (disable for self-signed certificates)
sources.nc_min_res_desc: Photos below this resolution are discarded after downloading (WebDAV doesn't provide the resolution in advance). 0 = no filter. Already cached photos below this are automatically removed on the next sync.
sources.im_api_key_hint: In Immich: Settings → API Keys → New API Key
sources.im_min_res_desc: Photos below this resolution are not downloaded (0 = no filter). Prevents visible pixelation from upscaling originals that are already low-resolution. Already cached photos below this are automatically removed on the next sync.
slideshow_page.transitions_desc: Multiple selection possible. If several are enabled, the slideshow randomly switches between them for each image. At least one must be active.
slideshow_page.transition_duration_hint: Applies to all transitions except Ken Burns and None.
slideshow_page.fit_cover: Cover – image fills screen (may be cropped)
slideshow_page.fit_smart: Smart – zoom in partway to shrink bars without cropping as much
slideshow_page.smart_fit_hint: 0% behaves like Contain (full image, bars allowed), 100% like Cover (always fills, crops as needed). E.g. 30% zooms in 30% of the way there - shrinks the bars on a mismatched photo (like an upright photo on a widescreen display) without cropping as aggressively as a full Cover would.
slideshow_page.video_audio_hint: Without audio, the picture frame works better as background decor.
slideshow_page.video_audio_unsupported_h: Your connected display doesn't report HDMI audio support (checked via EDID) - audio is disabled as a result. This can't be fixed in software; a USB audio adapter would work, since the Pi Zero 2 W has no built-in audio jack.
slideshow_page.video_player_hint: mpv is the current default. VLC is an alternative hardware-accelerated player, though a playback-pacing bug was found on this hardware. ZeroPlay is a lightweight player built specifically for this device/OS combo - worth trying if videos stutter.
slideshow_page.min_one_transition_alert: Please keep at least one transition enabled.

display_page.heading: Display & Power
display_page.auto_shutdown_desc: For operation on a timer / smart plug: the Pi shuts itself down cleanly instead of having the power cut abruptly (protects the SD card). Set the time at least 2–3 minutes before your plug's off time. The Pi restarts automatically the next time the plug turns on.
display_page.delete_removed_label: Remove locally cached images once removed from the server
display_page.video_transcode_label: Re-encode videos to reduce stuttering (recommended for the Zero 2 W)
display_page.video_transcode_hint: Off by default. When enabled, newly synced videos are capped at 720p / ~4.5 Mbit/s once, right after download, using whichever encoder is chosen below - independent of whatever quality Immich/Nextcloud serves everyone else. Only affects videos synced after this is turned on; already-cached ones are untouched unless the cache is cleared.
display_page.transcode_mode_hardware: Hardware (fast, uses the Pi's own video encoder chip)
display_page.transcode_mode_hw_unavailab: This device's hardware encoder isn't available (not detected, or not working) - only software encoding can be used here.
display_page.media_processing_hint: Where photo downscaling and video transcoding actually happen. Local uses this device's own CPU (and, for video, the hardware/software choice below). Remote sends both photos and videos that need work over the network to a separate machine instead - useful if this device's hardware video encoder is unreliable, or its CPU is too weak for fast software encoding.
display_page.media_processing_remote: Remote (a separate machine on the network)
display_page.remote_service_hint: Set up via the install.sh in this project's remote-transcode-service/ folder, run on the target machine (e.g. a Proxmox LXC CT) - that script prints the URL and API key to enter here once it's done.
display_page.install_update_confirm: Install the available update now? The web UI and slideshow will restart (a full install can take several minutes).
slideshow_page.photo_info_hint: Shows a small bar at the bottom with the date taken and place, when available. Only works for photos/videos synced from Immich - Immich provides this automatically; Nextcloud/WebDAV items show nothing since that information isn't available from there.
slideshow_page.clear_cache_desc: Deletes all downloaded images. The next sync will download them again.
slideshow_page.clear_cache_confirm: Really delete all images from the cache?
install.placeholder_line2: the slideshow will restart automatically afterwards.
boot.splash_line1: Please wait, your photos will appear shortly.
shutdown.splash_line1: It's now safe to disconnect power once the screen goes dark.
api.update_no_source_dir: No source directory recorded - run a full install first
api.update_check_failed: Could not check for updates (network or git error)
